title: Custom Paper Bags for Retail Brands: Details Buyers Should Confirm
buyer_question: What paper bag details should retail brands confirm before ordering?
short_answer: Retail brands should confirm bag size, paper material, handle type, print coverage, surface finish, product weight, store or event use case and sustainability wording before ordering custom paper bags. A paper bag RFQ is clearer when the buyer separates appearance requirements from carrying strength and documentation needs.
